newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group low sulphur diesel firms.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group low sulphur diesel firms.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel differentials firmed in the Group Three spot market late Monday against easing front-month heating oil prices, traders said.
Chicago diesel fuel and unleaded gasoline differentials were largely unchanged, leaving prices to track futures in thin spot trade on the day, traders said.
"It's deathly quiet," one trader active in the Group Three and Chicago spot markets said.
Group Three low sulphur diesel for April deliveries firmed one cent a gallon to bids 4.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX May heating oil in Group Three and remained 4.75 cents over the print in Chicago.
High sulphur diesel was talked unchanged at 2.0/2.25 cents a gallon over the print in Group Three and 2.25 cents over in Chicago for April deliveries, traders said.

Group Three unleaded gasoline for April deliveries was steady at 3.0/2.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX May unleaded, with Chicago summer-grade unleaded heard done 2.60 cents a gallon under the print early in the day.
